kitEvidence.formula:
Akshan locks onto a champion and begins overcharging his gun for up to [2.5] seconds, storing up to [5 / 6 / 7] bullets.

Recast: Akshan unleashes the stored bullets, each dealing at least [(25 / 35 / 45 + (0.15) × AD) × ((1 + ((0.3) × Stat(8)) × (((1) × Stat(9) + -1))))] physical damage to the first enemy or structure hit, increased up to [((25 / 35 / 45 + (0.15) × AD) × ((1 + ((0.3) × Stat(8)) × (((1) × Stat(9) + -1))))) × (3)] physical damage based on missing Health.

builds.name: Heroic Swing: counted-shot AD and attack-speed test
builds.summary: Investigate high Heroic Swing shots in one three-second observation output under fixed, reproducible conditions; compare one-slot swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high Heroic Swing shots in one three-second observation output under fixed, reproducible conditions; compare one-slot swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: The per-shot helper is (8/16/24/32/40 + 0.25 total AD) times (1 + 0.3 times the bonus-attack-speed stat term). Bonus attack speed therefore has potential beyond ordinary attack frequency, but its stat normalization and the number of legal shots must be observed. Collision and release can end the swing. A separate critical helper scales the core by 1 + 0.5 times (critical-damage stat minus 1); this is a special critical rule, not automatic ordinary-attack crit inheritance.

ceiling.targetName: Heroic Swing shots in one three-second observation
ceiling.finiteState: Level 18, selected ability maximum learned rank, minute 30. Enemy champion: 3000 maximum HP, 100 armor and 50 MR. No dragons, elixirs or allied stat buffs. No free permanent stacks. Record actual AD/AP and resists. Loaded owner HP 100%, target HP 100%, observation 3s. Gathering Storm at minute 30 if selected. Stop observed scoring on death and report raw overkill separately. Exactly 10 earned Hubris kills with its temporary AD buff active. One uninterrupted legal swing, no takedown refresh; count actual shots and final disengage shot that occur within three seconds. Isolate one champion from other selectable enemies. Owner begins at full health.

kitEvidence.formula:
First Cast: Akshan fires a grappling hook, attaching to the first terrain hit.

Second Cast: Akshan swings around the terrain, repeatedly firing at the nearest enemy for [(8 / 16 / 24 / 32 / 40 + (0.25) × AD) × ((1 + (0.3) × Stat(4)[statFormula=2]))] physical damage per shot.

Third Cast: Akshan dives off the rope, firing a final shot.

Colliding with an enemy Champion or terrain ends the swing early.

Champion takedowns refresh this Ability's Cooldown.
